basics.name: Redji Jean Baptiste
basics.label: Computer Systems Technician Student
basics.description: Co-operative education student at Algonquin College in the Computer Systems Technician - Networking program with extensive security operations experience. Skilled in physical security systems, access control, video surveillance, and incident response. Seeking opportunities to apply technical knowledge and security expertise in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity roles.

work.summary: Provided comprehensive security services and hotel-level guest assistance in a 51-story luxury hotel environment, serving 400+ residences and hotel guests daily
highlights: Operated Avigilon CCTV surveillance system monitoring 80+ IP cameras across multiple building zones
Administered HID Global access control infrastructure and VingCard Visionline system to manage all guest, resident, and staff credentials
Conducted access control investigations by reviewing Visionline audit trails during security incidents
Responded to emergency situations with average response time under 2 minutes

work.summary: Conducted comprehensive financial analysis and due diligence on equity and fixed-income securities for a simulated student-managed investment portfolio
highlights: Collaborated with team of student analysts to develop investment strategies and perform sector research
Utilized financial modelling software and advanced Excel functions to analyze market trends
Participated in weekly investment committee meetings, presenting research findings
Developed expertise in ESG investing principles and sustainable finance practices

work.summary: Engaged in security operations in a high-traffic entertainment complex serving 5,000+ daily visitors across gaming floors, restaurants, and event spaces
highlights: Operated Avigilon Unity/ACC video management platform with integrated SAFR facial recognition module
Deployed Avigilon License Plate Recognition solution to capture and verify vehicle plates
Coordinated hourly patrols covering 200,000 sq ft and monitored 50+ CCTV cameras
Collaborated with local law enforcement; de-escalated conflicts and managed crowd control

work.summary: Provided comprehensive security services across multiple client locations including commercial complexes, construction sites, retail establishments, and public events
highlights: Engaged in security operations for diverse properties ranging from 10,000 to 500,000 sq ft
Conducted detailed risk assessments and implemented enhanced security protocols
Utilized advanced surveillance technology including IP camera systems
Developed strong relationships with property managers and tenants

work.summary: Collaborated with school board officials, community leaders, and fellow organizers to plan, promote, and execute the annual Black Youth Forum
highlights: Coordinated with guest speakers and workshop facilitators to create engaging content
Developed and managed budgets, securing sponsorships and allocating resources
Conducted post-event evaluations to inform improvements and ensure continued growth
